high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from the website "www.primetimer.com." The headline reads: "NBC cancels Suits LA after one season due to low viewership and limited impact." The article discusses the cancellation of the television series "Suits LA" by NBC. It mentions that in May 2025, NBC confirmed that the show would not return for a second season. The network has not provided further details regarding potential spin-offs or future extensions of the franchise.
